title: Partner programme
description: For a programme with resellers, integrators, referral partners or marketplaces: written terms, no imposed resale prices, a channel conflict rule and clear data roles.

sources.title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2022/720, Vertical Block Exemption Regulation
European Commission, Vertical block exemptions and Guidelines on vertical restraints

rules.instruction: Write the partner tiers, entry criteria, benefits and obligations in a programme guide shared with partners.
rules.verification: Open the programme guide and check that each tier has criteria, benefits and obligations.

rules.instruction: Have legal review the partner agreement template so that it may recommend or cap resale prices but never fixes them or imposes a minimum.
rules.verification: Check that the task record links legal's review of the template and that no clause sets a fixed or minimum resale price.

rules.instruction: Write how deals are registered and who owns a deal when a partner and the direct team meet the same customer.
rules.verification: Check that the rule is in the programme guide and that the CRM has a deal registration field.

rules.instruction: State in the partner agreement who is controller and who is processor of end-customer data, and sign a data processing agreement where one is required.
rules.verification: Open the agreement template and check the data roles clause and the data processing agreement annex.
